model_basis.identity: Curated seed record in data/nodes.json. Name, operator and coordinates were assembled from operator/agency records during the build sprint and cross-checked against the in-repo EIA-860 and OSM layers where a match exists. Operator confirmation is still pending; treat identity as curated, not audited.
model_basis.electrical: Modelled electrical rating derived from the site's published scale and process class. This is not an operator-published meter value. Formula and assumptions are documented in README §4.1 and §4.2.
model_basis.carbon: Modelled grid carbon intensity and source mix for the serving zone (US-CAL-CAMX). Replace with an EPA eGRID subregion snapshot and an ISO fuel-mix snapshot when those captures are added.
model_basis.economics: Screening unit economics from the README §4.1 bundle and the lib/grid.ts UNIT table. Not a quote, bid or approved capital plan.
model_basis.upgrade: Recommended screening bundle: on-site solar plus a drive retrofit. Sized from nameplate draw, not from a site audit.

notes: Reverse geocode of the profile anchor point. Confirms the Census state/county containing the point; it does not confirm that a facility occupies it.
In-repo radius-clipped subset. `artifact.count` counts features in the exact snapshot; it does not claim a national EIA total.
In-repo OSM extract. Missing geometry is not evidence that a line does not exist.
In-repo OSM extract. Presence is not proof of energisation.

disclosures.subject: region:westminster-100mi
disclosures.text: Every nameplate MW, utilization and motor efficiency on the 11 load centers is modelled. None is an operator-published meter reading. The UI labels those claims MODELED.

disclosures.subject: region:westminster-100mi
disclosures.text: Carbon intensity and source mix are modelled for the serving grid zone. A live eGRID/ISO capture is the next evidence upgrade.

disclosures.subject: region:westminster-100mi
disclosures.text: Capex, savings and payback are screening estimates. They exclude incentives, escalation, financing and site-specific engineering.

disclosures.subject: region:westminster-100mi
disclosures.text: Generation, transmission and substation layers are radius-clipped in-repo artifacts. The snapshot hash proves which artifact was counted; upstream row locators are not preserved.

disclosures.subject: region:westminster-100mi
disclosures.text: OpenStreetMap coverage is community-maintained and incomplete. Counts are lower bounds on mapped features, not asset inventories.
